text.tspan: ENTRYPOINT is what runs, CMD is the default arguments
Kubernetes pod spec: command: replaces ENTRYPOINT · args: replaces CMD
Always use exec form ["a", "b"]: shell form runs /bin/sh as PID 1, and SIGTERM never reaches your app.
